content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR-CIRCOT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the ICAR-CIRCOT Young Professional posts is 17-08-2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Young Professional posts is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: For Young Professional-I, a Graduate degree with at least 60% marks in Computer Application, IT, CS, AI, or related fields is required. Alternatively, a Graduate degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, or Media Studies with 60% marks is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: For Young Professional-II, a Graduate degree with 60% marks in relevant IT/CS fields and one year of experience, or a Master's degree in Computer Application/IT/CS/AI or related fields is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The salary for Young Professional-I is Rs. 30,000/- per month, and for Young Professional-II, it is Rs. 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Young Professional posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ICAR-CIRCOT recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the ICAR-CIRCOT located?
faq.answer: ICAR-CIRCOT is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400019.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Young Professional (Information Technology) posts.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these posts is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.
